about.title: Loma Linda Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Loma Linda residents rely on everyday products — from vehicle parts and medical devices tied to the city's healthcare institutions, to household appliances and tools bought along Redlands Boulevard or Mountain View Avenue — trusting that they were built and tested safely. When a product fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can happen in an instant, whether at home, at work, or while driving near I-10. California's approach to product liability often centers on strict liability, meaning the injured person generally doesn't have to prove the manufacturer was negligent, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused harm. That can make these claims move differently than a typical accident case. If a defective product injured you in Loma Linda, keeping the item exactly as it was at the time of the incident can matter a great deal, and LawProactive can connect you at no cost with an independent attorney who handles these claims.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often rely on strict liability, which generally focuses on whether the product itself was defective — in its design, manufacturing, or warnings — and whether that defect caused your injury. This can be different from a typical negligence case where fault is the central question.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, including packaging, instructions, and any broken pieces. Physical evidence is often critical in these claims, and altering or discarding the product can make it harder to establish what went wrong.

items.question: Is this specific to Loma Linda, or could it happen anywhere?
items.answer: Defective products can cause harm anywhere, but Loma Linda's mix of medical facilities, family neighborhoods, and busy corridors like Barton Road and Redlands Boulevard means residents encounter a wide range of consumer, medical, and vehicle-related products daily. If one of them failed and caused injury here, an independent attorney can look at the specific facts of your situation.
